metrics.hot_loop_seconds: Time spent in key generation + lookup loop
metrics.startup_seconds: Wall time minus hot_loop_seconds (load + sort funded.tsv)
metrics.wall_seconds: Total real time for the full command

entries.title: --formats flag to skip address types
entries.notes: Default --formats all unchanged. Omitting taproot (--formats legacy,segwit,p2sh) ~125k keys/s in spot check.

entries.title: Verbosity for funded.tsv check at startup
entries.notes: Funded data check section with local/remote dates and up-to-date line; --quiet skips. Hot loop unchanged.

entries.title: Persist discovered wallets to wallets.txt
entries.notes: Append-only wallets.txt on real hits only; simulate-hit excluded. Hot-loop unchanged.

entries.title: Output UX — pretty terminal, progress, wallet recovery
entries.notes: Centralized UI layer, TTY progress, hit recovery banner. Hot-loop unchanged; delta is run variance.

entries.title: Simulate-hit flag for testing
entries.notes: CLI test flags: --simulate-hit, --simulate-hit-verify-lookup, --inject-index-hit. Default path unchanged. Delta is run variance.

entries.title: Hand-rolled address encoding
entries.notes: Hit-path encoding via base58.CheckEncode and bech32/bech32m primitives (no Address types). 10k-key cross-validation vs btcd passes. Hot loop unchanged — encode only runs on hits; delta is run variance.

entries.title: Batch keys per goroutine
entries.notes: Workers send batches of 128 wallets over channel; consumer iterates locally. Hot loop +11.4% vs medium-02 from reduced channel sync overhead.

entries.title: Bloom filter pre-check
entries.notes: Per-bucket bloom filters (0.01% FP) with two-stage lookup. Cache extended to v2 to persist blooms (677MB); v1 auto-upgrades on first run. Cache hit 0.73s. Hot loop +5% vs high-02.

entries.title: Preprocess funded.tsv into cache file
entries.notes: Binary funded.cache (606MB) keyed on funded.tsv mtime. Cache hit: load 0.64s vs ~56s TSV parse+sort. Four bucket counts match; Other (593K) not cached. Hot loop unchanged.

entries.title: Hash-based lookup (no string encode)
entries.notes: LookupKeys with hash160/taproot derivation; byte-slice search via matchFunded; address encoding only on hit. Hot loop +15.7% vs medium-01. secp256k1 keygen still dominates — below plan's 2-5x estimate.

entries.title: Partition funded set by address type
entries.notes: FundedSets with legacy/p2sh/segwit/taproot byte slices plus Other for non-decodable rows. Fast load decode via base58/bech32. Load+decode 44.6s, sort 11.5s (startup +166% vs medium-04). Hot loop -1.1%. Total unchanged: 31,733,986.

entries.title: Faster TSV parsing at startup
entries.notes: Byte-level TSV parse with 1MB scanner buffer and 32M slice capacity. Parse 3.74s, sort 17.22s. Startup -25% vs low-04. Loaded count unchanged: 31,733,986.

entries.title: Default thread count to CPU count
entries.notes: Convenience change only — threads arg now optional, defaults to runtime.NumCPU(). Standard benchmark unchanged.

entries.title: Defer WIF encoding until hit
entries.notes: WIF base58 encoding moved from GenKeypair to hit branch only. Modest gain — address string encoding still dominates hot loop.

entries.title: Fix worker count (use all threads)
entries.notes: First tracked benchmark after high-04. Replaces threads-1 worker spawn with full thread count.

entries.title: Before high-04 (informal)
entries.notes: Informal pre-tracking benchmark. Different command params — not directly comparable to standard_command.
